significance: A Shiva temple at Theeyathur in Pudukkottai district whose presiding lingam is called Sahasralakshmeeswarar, with Periyanayaki as goddess and a large complement of subsidiary shrines.
story: Vishnu is said to have worshipped Shiva here with a thousand lotuses and, finding himself one short, offered his own eye; Shiva later gave darshan to Mahalakshmi when she made the same thousand-flower offering.
